score_scale.4: Strong independent, relevant and reproducible support

missing_evidence: unknown; null score; never zero or inferred disapproval
aggregation: No overall score until weights and calibration are validated; report dimension scores and evidence coverage separately.

specialists.name: Comparator Credibility
specialists.question: How credible and decision-relevant is the benchmark used to support claims about a product's clinical, scientific, or commercial performance?

dimensions.assess: Relevance to population, treatment line, biomarker, geography and clinical or buyer decision
dimensions.evidence: Dated guidelines, regulator precedents, payer policies, pivotal trials and credible utilization data
dimensions.penalize: Obsolete, weak, geographically irrelevant, cherry-picked or straw-man benchmarks; supportive care when an active standard exists

dimensions.assess: Randomization, prospective controls, prespecification, blinding and protection against selection or measurement bias
dimensions.evidence: Active-control trials, allocation concealment, stratification, blinded central review, analysis plans and regulator-agreed designs
dimensions.penalize: Unadjusted cross-trial claims, post-hoc external controls, single-arm comparative proof, non-concurrent controls and undocumented choices

dimensions.assess: Population comparability, sample and event counts, precision, uncertainty, multiplicity and statistical integrity
dimensions.evidence: Eligibility alignment, baseline balance, overlap diagnostics, subgroup justification, confidence intervals, sensitivity analyses, missing-data handling and robust errors
dimensions.penalize: Different lines, responder enrichment, healthier patients, incompatible biomarkers, prior-therapy imbalance, poor common support, nominal multiple-look p-values, underpowered subgroups, hidden wide intervals, inappropriate pooling and outcome-selected models

dimensions.assess: Same clinical question, endpoint definition, timing, adjudication, censoring and estimand
dimensions.evidence: Matched response criteria, assessment schedules, follow-up, clinically important differences and absolute effects
dimensions.penalize: Surrogate substitution, investigator/central-review mismatch, incompatible censoring, selective timepoints, relative-only effects and endpoint switching

dimensions.assess: Events and follow-up sufficient for survival, durability and safety claims
dimensions.evidence: Event fraction, follow-up, numbers at risk, intervals, proportional-hazards checks, durability curves, late toxicity and successive data cuts
dimensions.penalize: Immature tails, unstable estimates, informative censoring, tiny risk sets and updated company data compared with stale benchmarks

dimensions.assess: Era, geography, care setting, diagnostic capability, access, transparency, independence and reproducibility
dimensions.evidence: Concurrent controls or aligned dates; countries, subsequent therapy, crossover, background care and practice mix; regulatory reviews, full reports, protocols, independent datasets, disclosed methods/code and replication
dimensions.penalize: Unmodeled practice changes, regional care differences, pandemic effects, tertiary-center generalization, investor-deck-only evidence, hand-picked literature, inaccessible cohorts, unvalidated sponsor abstraction, duplicate datasets and undisclosed conflicts

dimensions.assess: Clinical, regulatory, reimbursement and adoption relevance of the difference
dimensions.evidence: Absolute benefit, NNT/NNH, quality of life, toxicity, convenience, discontinuation, resource use, total cost and prespecified margins
dimensions.penalize: Statistical significance without clinical importance, benefit offset by toxicity or burden, price-only comparisons and mismatch to intended label or buyer

specialists.name: Western Validation
specialists.question: To what extent has a product or platform been independently validated by credible Western institutions with real scientific, regulatory, clinical, or commercial commitment?
specialists.interpretation: Report named institution and jurisdiction. Western geography is the user's target-market lens, not evidence of intrinsic scientific superiority. Do not infer commitment from a logo or filing status alone.

dimensions.assess: Institution reputation, domain fit, standing and independence
dimensions.evidence: Named regulators, academic centers, biopharma, independent journals, payers and health systems with indication expertise
dimensions.penalize: Affiliates, paid advisers, distributor-only ties, unverifiable logos and undisclosed conflicts

dimensions.assess: Cost, selectivity and reversibility of the action
dimensions.evidence: Executed licenses/options, investment, sponsorship, co-development, procurement, named grants, accepted filings, activated sites and independent replication funding
dimensions.penalize: Non-binding MOUs, exploratory meetings, generic collaboration language, attendance and company-funded endorsements; distinguish filing acceptance from approval

dimensions.assess: Validation independent of solely company-controlled data or analysis
dimensions.evidence: External replication/labs, peer review, regulator inspection, external protocol ownership and multi-institution consistency
dimensions.penalize: Circular citations, reused datasets, sponsored content presented as independent and unverifiable single sources

dimensions.assess: Direct applicability to product, indication, population, stage and target market
dimensions.evidence: FDA, EMA, MHRA and Health Canada interactions, trial authorization, designation, protocol agreement and relevant ethics approval
dimensions.penalize: Platform praise transferred to another asset or non-comparable indication; designation treated as efficacy approval

specialists.name: Key Opinion Leaders
specialists.question: How strong, independent, relevant and behaviorally engaged is the expert network surrounding the asset?
specialists.kol_definition: A resolved person with documented disease/modality expertise and at least one dated substantive influence indicator: guideline authorship, relevant trial leadership, society leadership, regulator advisory work, or a disease-specific research record demonstrating peer uptake. Title, employer prestige, follower count and paid quotation alone do not qualify. This is an operational candidate definition pending expert validation.

dimensions.assess: Disease, modality and clinical-setting expertise and influence
dimensions.evidence: Guidelines, trial leadership, relevant publications/citations, society roles, referral-center position, advisory participation and peer-recognized expertise
dimensions.penalize: Generic fame, weak indication fit, inflated titles, predatory publications and follower-count-only influence

dimensions.assess: Independent expert quality, geographic breadth and institutional diversity
dimensions.evidence: Multiple centers, relevant Western regions and specialties, and community practice where relevant
dimensions.penalize: One-center clusters, company-created panels, repeated same-lab coauthors and celebrity dependence

dimensions.assess: Effort, reputational commitment and substantive engagement with evidence and limitations
dimensions.evidence: PI/steering roles, protocol authorship, investigator trials, guidelines, invited science, repeated collaboration, adoption research and specific balanced discussion across data updates
dimensions.penalize: Single quotes, paid webinars, passive boards, photos, boilerplate, copied enthusiasm, claims outside expertise and unexplained inconsistency; silence is unknown, never disapproval

dimensions.assess: Credibility accounting for financial and professional ties
dimensions.evidence: Disclosures, external funding, balanced commentary, pre-engagement activity and uncompensated expertise
dimensions.penalize: Consulting concentration, stock ownership, undisclosed payments, ghostwriting signals, coordinated promotion and company-controlled channels; conflicts must be evidenced

dimensions.assess: Network resilience and growth through time
dimensions.evidence: Independent-node growth, cross-institution bridges, qualified new investigators, repeat engagement, concentration and retention after adverse events
dimensions.penalize: Bot-like amplification, duplicate people, promotional bursts, departures, retractions and dependence on one broker

specialists.name: Talent Migration
specialists.question: Does the pattern of people joining, leaving or concentrating around the company reveal informed confidence or execution risk?
specialists.milestone_definition: Use a versioned product/indication milestone timeline from registry versions, dated regulatory records and explicitly attributed company guidance available at the cutoff. Preserve planned versus actual, uncertainty and revisions. If no defensible next milestone is known, role-to-milestone relevance is unknown; never infer an earlier forecast from a later outcome.

dimensions.assess: Function materiality to documented upcoming milestones
dimensions.evidence: Clinical, regulatory, CMC, translational, commercial, business-development, quality and indication leadership relative to trials, filings, scale-up or launch
dimensions.penalize: Equal weighting of all hires, generic roles overweighted and hires unrelated to execution

dimensions.assess: Relevant role-level achievements, recency and fit to modality, stage and problem
dimensions.evidence: Approvals, trials, scale-up, launches, research/patents and increasing responsibility attributable to the person
dimensions.penalize: Prestige without fit, unverifiable bios, unexplained short tenure, inflated titles and employer success credited to an individual

dimensions.assess: Information content of origin and destination
dimensions.evidence: Relevant peers, regulators, labs and biopharma; distinguish retirement, academia, stronger peers and unrelated sectors
dimensions.penalize: Every hire positive/every departure negative; ignoring layoffs, acquisitions, geography and personal circumstances; do not invent motives

dimensions.assess: Complementary capabilities assembling around a program or milestone
dimensions.evidence: Clinical, regulatory, biostatistics, CMC and commercial clusters, prior-team ties, hubs and milestone-consistent sequencing
dimensions.penalize: Duplicate postings, recruiter noise, backfills as expansion and acquisition transfers as organic hiring

dimensions.assess: Capability stability, succession and unusual flow acceleration versus own history and matched peers
dimensions.evidence: Tenure-adjusted retention, orderly succession, internal promotion, handoffs, low regretted attrition and post-event retention
dimensions.penalize: Critical-leader churn, simultaneous departures, vacancies, abrupt removals, repeated interims and whole-team losses; absent public reporting is not proof of retention

specialists.name: Trial Quality
specialists.question: Are selected and activated institutions likely to recruit appropriate patients, execute reliably and produce credible regulator-ready data?
specialists.aggregation_policy: Only resolved site/product/company mappings; report activation state, represented sites, missing sites and dated weights. Do not assume equal enrollment or use future realized enrollment as earlier weights. No numeric aggregate until validated.

dimensions.assess: PI/team experience, stability, bandwidth and compliance
dimensions.evidence: Similar trials, enrollment history, research quality, coordinators, turnover, GCP standing and sanctions resolution
dimensions.penalize: Honorary PI involvement, overstretch, turnover, warning letters, debarment and undisclosed conflicts; distinguish site-specific findings and resolution dates

dimensions.assess: Accessible eligible population after competition and screening constraints
dimensions.evidence: Referral networks, registries, historical screening/enrollment, demographics, catchment, prescreening and competing trials
dimensions.penalize: Company forecasts without site history, overlapping referral pools, high screening failure and forecasts reconstructed after outcomes

dimensions.assess: Completeness, timeliness and protocol adherence
dimensions.evidence: Startup, queries, missingness, visits, deviations, samples, review concordance, retention and database lock
dimensions.penalize: Outcome-dependent closure, selective reports, implausible distributions, excessive deviations, delayed entry, missing verification and audits; unavailable private metrics remain unknown

dimensions.assess: Demonstrated capacity for treatment and complex endpoints
dimensions.evidence: Prior analogous work, accredited labs, imaging, pathology, surgery, ICU, cold chain, identity/custody, genomics, pharmacy and multidisciplinary care
dimensions.penalize: Marketing-only claims and unvalidated outsourced handoffs

dimensions.assess: Geography and population fit to filing, label and market
dimensions.evidence: ICH-GCP environment, regulator acceptability, diversity, care comparability, ethics readiness and regional mix
dimensions.penalize: Atypical care, incompatible standards, weak oversight, interruption risk and target-market mismatch; geography alone does not establish site quality

dimensions.assess: Qualified-site diversification without ineffective over-expansion
dimensions.evidence: Enrollment spread, backup sites, concentration, activation pipeline and capability redundancy
dimensions.penalize: Too many low-productivity sites, single-site dependence, correlated disruptions and late rescue sites masking delay
